slides.heading: f-Strings
slides.body: f-Strings is part of Mathematical and String Operations. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: f-Strings
slides.body: An f-string lets you insert variable values directly into text using braces. It makes messages easier to format.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: An f-string is like a certificate template where the name is filled into a blank space.

slides.body: Python follows operator rules exactly. Use variables and parentheses to make calculations readable and predictable.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Use an f-string to print Hi, followed by the value of name.
